name: Rise Line
northStar: Show the data bakers have been guessing at: one honest curve of a starter rising and falling.

engine.source: Scientific lab notebook plots: a single measured curve, annotations in the margin.
engine.evidence: Home bakers obsess over timing; nobody has ever shown them the curve.

tone._why: Precise and credible; a gadget for nerds that respects them.

skeleton: Full-width stack: a one-line headline across the top, then a full-bleed chart of 14 hours of rise with the peak annotated; specs and CTA in a single row underneath.

color.from: Lab-paper blue-gray and a marker pink for the peak.
